verdict.rationale: Transcription is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, but the pack never documents real-time transcription accuracy or any control over the STT provider, transcription model, or key terms. The LLM selection in docs-41 governs the agent's reasoning model, not speech-to-text, so it is an adjacent feature. Transcript retention settings and generic 'leading accuracy' marketing do not show configurable real-time transcription.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms
